method.point: geometric mean of eight paired-block candidate/baseline ratios; each block averages its two processes per arm
method.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap of eight complete paired four-process blocks, 10000 draws, seed1972; descriptive small-sample intervals, not causal proof
method.order_split: geometric mean block ratios within four ABBA or four BAAB blocks
method.raw_arm_means: arithmetic mean across16 processes/arm; CPU is user+system, wall includes startup, RSS is process high-water KiB
method.historical1972: Current A/B correctness costs and B/C optimization do not establish resolution of the original historical regression
